training_regime: Supervised joint training: frame BCE (weight 15) plus text autoregressive NLL (weight 1), frozen BLIP encoder with trainable temporal/decoder components.
features: BLIP ViT-B/16 image encoder (12 layers), one Temporal Transformer layer, 12-layer text decoder; CA window size 5.
sampling: Frames resized and center-cropped to 224x224; maximum video sequence length 512 with truncation (Section V-B). Original-paper sampling rate not restated in inspected passage.
runs: One reported configuration; independent seed count not reported.
source_location: Table III, PDF page 7 (printed page 7), Cross-Modal Video Summarization block, + TT + CA row; preprocessing Section V-B and evaluation Section V-C.
setting: Visual output (V2V-SUM metric) of joint VTSUM-BLIP + TT + CA.
segmentation: Frame-level selection; not KTS keyshot segmentation.
shot_aggregation: Not applied; binary frame inclusion.
budget: Paper: intended top 15% of input frames (Section IV-B). Inspected release uses inclusive threshold at zero-based floor(0.15*N): floor(0.15*N)+1 frames with distinct scores, possibly more with ties.
solver: Released F1 helper sorts scores and thresholds inclusively; no KTS segmentation or duration knapsack.
reference_aggregation: Paper: mean F1 over ten annotations per video. Inspected eval_v2vt_sum.py computes F1 for each human mask and reports mean/max across masks, then mean across videos; the mean path matches the paper-described aggregation. Rank correlations instead use the mean of ten masks.
comparability_notes: Frame summary protocol differs from traditional keyshot F1. This is the visual output of the joint model, not the VSUM-BLIP single-output row (23.1). The reported value is retained from Table III; source inspection does not establish that the inspected commit generated it. Preserve truncation, reference pairing and the inclusive-threshold budget caveat. No independent rerun.
